content: Isra7eele Asaa Un7etetha
Banta soo asaa ubba ekidi, Yayqoobara Gibxe bida Isra7eele adde nayta sunthay haysafe kaallidi xaafetidaysa;
Entika Robeela, Simoona, Leewe, Yihuda,
Yisakoora, Zabloona, Biniyaame,
Daane, Niftaaleme, Gaadenne Aseera.
Yayqooba sheeshati ubbay laapun tamma. Yoosefi kaseka Gibxen de7ees.
Wodepe guyen Yoosefi, iya ishatinne he yeletetha ubbay hayqidosona.
Shin Isra7eele sheeshay yeletidi Gibxe biitta kumana gakanaw taybon daridosonanne minnidosona.
Hessafe guye, Yoosefa eronna hara kawoy Gibxe biittan kawotis.
He kawoy ba asaa, “Heko, ha Isra7eeleti nuupe aadhidi yeletethaninne wolqan daridosona.
Nuuni hiillatonna ixiko enti taybon kaseysafe haa darana. Qoponna oli dendiko enti nu morketara issifidi nuna olidi, biitta yeggidi baanaw danda7oosona” yaagis.
Hessa gisho, deexo ooson enta un7ethana mela enta bolla iita kaapota wothidosona. Enti Pitoomanne Ramse geetetiya shallo wothiya katamata kawas keexidosona.
Shin Gibxeti enta darsi un7ethinka enti haa daridi yeletidosonanne biitta gakidosona. Gibxeti Isra7eeleta ixida gisho yayyidosona.
Entana iita ooso oosisidosona.
Urqa yedhison, siminton xuube medhon qassi gade oosison enta de7uwa camisidosona. Qadhey bayna deexo ooso ubbaa enta oosisidosona.
Gibxe kawoy qantha Ibraawe maccasata ulo pittiya Sipooronne Puuho geetetiya nam7u maccasatako haysada yaagis;
“Ibraawe maccasati yeliya wode yeletida na7ay adde gidiko wodhite, shin macca gidiko paxa aggite” yaagis.
Shin ulo piteysati Xoosse babbidi, Gibxe kawoy kiitidaysada oothibookona. Enti adde nayta paxa aggidosona.
Hessafe guye, Gibxe kawoy he ulo pitteyisata xeegidi, “Hinte ayis haysa oothidetii? Adde nayta ayis paxa aggetii?” yaagidi enta oychis.
Ulo piteysati zaaridi, “Ibraawe maccasati Gibxe maccasata mela gidokona. Enti mino gidiya gisho ulo piteysati gakanaape sinthatidi yeloosona” yaagidosona.
Hessa gisho, Xoossay ulo pitteysatas keehis. Isra7eele asay kaseysafe haa darshenne minnishe bidosona.
Qassi ulo piteysati Xoossas yayyida gisho Xoossay entaw enta soo asi immis.
Hessafe guye, kawoy ba asaa ubbaako, “Ibraawetape yeletiya adde ubbaa Nayle Shaafan yeggite; shin macca na7i yeletiko paxa aggite” yaagidi kiittis.
